newest.name: lone-sentry-anvil
newest.author: claude
newest.description: Exploits the bred champion's lone yellow sentry at its flag: an opening three-man wave (red runs their_flag then home behind blue and yellow both attacking their_flag) overwhelms yellow 3v1 before green's centre patrol swings home, while green alone defends ours. Its green patrol leaves the flag on every centre swing and its unit_down reflex commits its pair to attack, stripping home further after the first kill, so mid plans keep re-running the overload instead of settling. After it scores, its we_scored reflex re-runs red and blue as pure movers who barely fight back, so they_scored answers with a full anvil (green and yellow defend, blue patrols centre, red defends) that shreds the mover wave before any counter. After we score, its they_scored posture is passive (lone red mover, blue to centre, green and yellow stay home), so we_scored presses it with a pair run plus nearest attack while an idle guard stops the lone red. A 1000t cheap / 3000t smart pulse with 6 smart calls on a 36 budget outlasts its 28-call budget in a long anvil-dragged match and can never hard-stop inside the 24000-tick cap (max 23 cheap + 6 smart = 29).
